text:
Drawn by the scent of your aromas

and drunk on the wine of your breasts,

I forgot my flock in the fallow fields

and lost my song among the apples.


As doves in flight seek

the currents rocked in their beds,

through the mountain of narrow girdles

I will seek the places where you appear.


Now across the whole earth I will go lost,

leaving the song abandoned,

the helpless herd without guard,


since I forgot my love and my dwelling,

drawn by the scent of your orchards,

drunk on the wine of your breasts.

translation.title: Drawn by the Scent of Your Aromas...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the pastoral-erotic intoxication and the speaker's abandonment of song, flock, and home.
